name: Content Production Status Update
description: An admin logs in, navigates to the Content Production dashboard, locates the card for QA E2E Content Title, and changes the production status to In Progress.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the application login page
If a warning, reminder, or interstitial page appears with a button to continue (such as Click to Continue or Continue to Site), click that button to proceed to the application
Enter admin@quantira.com into the email address input field
Enter admin123 into the password input field
Click the Content Production sidebar navigation link
Verify that a production card containing the text QA E2E Content Title is visible on the page
Click the status select dropdown selector inside the production card for QA E2E Content Title
Select and click the In Progress status option from the dropdown menu
Verify that the status select dropdown inside the production card now shows In Progress
